full_page.content:
Page 32 Feb. Miss Clara Bast - 60 - sick Miss Chapman - presbitarn. - about 3 -- in poor health. 1938, March
Mar. 9th Mrs. Buberl - Tuomer on the brain feared, away from practice of faith for years - even at that charitable person. Hoping for grace to get back to Sacraments.
Mrs. Ellen Maimes - 80 - Cancer - broken hip & very poorly ... David Savoy - 6 - mastoids enrolled by phone in Ser. Mass As'n.
Wm. Eterno - 19 - run over by a truck when 5 yrs. old. Kidney trouble ever since - at times has fearful pains; has never been able to work; once a year to Holy Comm'n; Enrolled To-day in S.M. and advised to promise frequent Communion - etc
7 Roberta Mackey - 6 - in Ford's Hos. - brain trouble from measles. Drs. can do nothing. Father promises more frequent communion. En- rolled in Ser. Masses March 7th. March 11th ... Very hopeful ... Deo Gr. Enrolled perpetualy March 26th ... Surprising the doctors. Deo Gr.
Page 33 Mar. 2 Leigh Crane - 4 - has never heard, otherwise bright active child. The father is a baptist. His wife doubts if he were ever baptized. She herself has been going to holy Com. once a year. Enrolles boy To-day and promises weekly
Robert Fairbrothers of Pontiac - 15 - dying with spinal maingitis enrolled by long distance phone at time (before Xmas) is back in school and healthier than ever. Deo Grat.
Happy death of stray sheep - married 60 years - out of church - her brother a methodist Minister - hopes to die a Catholic a- did his Mother.
Walter Hughes - 2217 Lafayette - (colored) Out of work with wife & 3 - and cold
Edna Gabrigh - 38 - stroke ... four yrs. since 7th baby was born. Sometimes gets discouraged
